title: Frosted apple

techniques.name: Soft-focus field

blur.label: Focus blur
blur.note: Every blur the plate lays, the 14 px frost of the glass first, as a multiple of its own. Below 0.6 the pane stops reading as frosted; above 1.7 the blur bands at the pane’s lower edge.

frost.label: Frost
frost.note: How white the glass is (its 28% white tint), as a multiple.

panel.label: Panel width
panel.note: Width of the frosted pane, as a multiple of the page’s 270 px; it always covers the product word.

spark.label: Sparkle size
spark.note: Size of the four-point sparkles on the glass. 0 removes them.

fruit.label: Fruit size
fruit.note: Size of the citrus rounds behind the glass; they stay under the pane.

techniques.implementation: Flowers and lights drawn in sharp line and then softened: blur, glow and bokeh over a flat ground. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
